```{r}
library(quantmod)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
```

```{r}
# scrape BIZD

getSymbols('BIZD', src = 'yahoo', 
           from = "2010-01-01", to = Sys.Date())


bizd_data <- data.frame(
  BIZD,
  date = as.Date(rownames(data.frame(BIZD)))
)

write_xlsx(bizd_data, "/Users/fortressokorie/Desktop/Naafey_Fortress/bizd_data.xlsx")
```
